objective: Create a verifiable P0 contract and public evaluation baseline for Agentflow without changing host installation or adding a second runtime.
non_goals: Implement cross-session retrieval or vector search.
Switch the active Codex or Claude installation source.
assumptions: The host remains responsible for models, tools, permissions, and Agent lifecycle.
Private holdout cases will be supplied outside this repository when evaluation isolation is implemented.
The validator must run with the Python standard library only.

input_evidence.summary: Defines the P0 backlog and the boundary between the new workspace and the installed plugin.
Defines Bug and Plan role responsibilities and review gates.
Defines the host-native product boundary and staged improvement roadmap.

interfaces.contract: The command validates schemas, examples, and public eval cases and exits non-zero on structural or consistency errors.
interfaces.error_behavior: Print each failing path and reason, then return exit code 1.
interfaces.compatibility: Python 3 standard library; no external service or model invocation.

dependencies.description: Bug and plan schema fields must be stable before examples and evaluator fixtures are authored.
Public input fixtures must remain visible and sanitized.

work_packages.deliverable: Version-one Bug Record and Plan JSON Schemas with state and contract fields.
work_packages.verification: Validate positive and negative contract examples.

work_packages.deliverable: One sanitized valid Bug Record, one valid cross-layer Plan, and intentional invalid examples.
work_packages.verification: The contract validator accepts valid examples and rejects invalid examples.

work_packages.deliverable: Dependency-free validator with schema checks and plan/record invariants.
work_packages.verification: Run the validator against every public fixture and intentional failure.

work_packages.deliverable: Ten public cases covering role selection, review independence, replanning, and permission boundaries.
work_packages.verification: Validate all case records and confirm every input_ref resolves to a fixture.

work_packages.deliverable: Independent review of schema semantics, examples, public cases, and validator output.
work_packages.verification: Review the actual files and rerun the full validation command.

parallel_lanes.can_run_when: Immediately after the P0 scope is accepted.
After P0-1 defines the stable schema fields.
After all artifact and validator checks are available.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Bug Record and Plan documents have explicit required fields, enumerated states, and review/rollback evidence.
Positive examples pass and intentional invalid examples fail for an observable reason.
Ten public evaluation cases are structurally valid and reference existing sanitized inputs.

verification.expected: All schemas, examples, and public evaluation cases pass; intentional invalid examples are rejected as expected.

review_gates.check: Schema state transitions and plan execution boundaries are unambiguous.
Review the actual artifacts and validator output without modifying them.

rollback_points.trigger: A schema change invalidates existing role or improvement contracts.
rollback_points.action: Revert the P0 artifact batch before any installation switch.

rollback_points.trigger: Public cases or validator produce ambiguous or underpowered results.
rollback_points.action: Keep the active 0.3.1 installation unchanged and revise the P0 contracts.
